needed.evidence: The left side has no purpose-built sidewalk; people would have to walk on a narrow, uneven dirt strip or in the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous paved footway on the left side, set back from the carriageway, to give pedestrians a safe place to walk.

needed.evidence: The left-side walking strip is uneven, with loose gravel, mud and a broken edge that would trip a pedestrian.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the left-side walking strip with a firm, even surface to remove the trip hazards.

needed.evidence: There is clear crossing demand from the shops and homes on both sides, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is visible on this stretch.
needed.suggestion: Provide a marked pedestrian crossing at the point of highest demand, with good sightlines, to give people a safe place to cross.
